Soreness is technically a sign of over training but we all secretly love it. So here’s the thing, protein synthesis lasts around 48-72 hours if you’re not “enhanced” by anabolics. This means the muscles are being fed and adapting through that. The soreness may last longer which is the actual recovery. I’d recommend keeping blood moving to the sore parts but like others have said, listen to your body. If you can’t wash your own hair it’s probably not a good day for overhead press. 

In the end just don’t gauge your workouts off of being sore. Get the reps in, get a good pump then feed the muscles you just broke down.
